description: This file defines the 'Person' class in the OpenMRS healthcare system, representing a generic individual with properties like name, address, gender, birthdate, death date, and attributes. It includes methods for managing and retrieving personal information, calculating age, and handling associated entities such as addresses and names.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Represents a person in the system with personal details, relationships to addresses, names, attributes, and life events, along with methods to manage and compute personal data such as age.

methods.name: getAge
methods.description: Calculates the person's current age based on birthdate, considering death date if applicable.

methods.name: getAge(Date onDate)
methods.description: Calculates the person's age as of a specific date, considering death and birth date.

methods.name: getAgeInChronoUnit
methods.description: Helper method to compute age in a specified ChronoUnit (days, weeks, months).

methods.name: setBirthdateFromAge
methods.description: Sets the birthdate based on an age as of a specific date, marking the birthdate as estimated.

methods.name: getPersonName
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred non-voided name for the person.

methods.name: getPersonAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred non-voided address for the person.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds a new attribute or updates existing ones, handling voiding of previous attributes if necessary.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a non-voided attribute of a specific type or by name.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a specified attribute from the person's attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all attributes, optionally filtered by name or type.
